name: chicken
about: A hen of Việt Nam (gà ta): about 45 cm high at the top of the comb, red-brown feathers, a small red comb, yellow legs.
sources: Wikipedia, Chicken (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chicken): "Adult chickens of both sexes have a fleshy crest on their heads called a comb or cockscomb", "hanging flaps of skin on either side under their beaks called wattles", "combs and wattles are more prominent in males"; "The body is round, the legs are unfeathered in most breeds, and the wings are short"; "Size and coloration vary widely between breeds".

The height (45 cm at the top of the comb), the red-brown feathers, the dark tail and the yellow legs of a hen of Việt Nam: a guess from photos of iNaturalist (https://www.inaturalist.org/photos/92534456, https://www.inaturalist.org/photos/467736456).
